summary: DAY structural/causal pass completed independently for all 12 active-batch companies using cumulative valid evidence. All 12 retain reproducible human-need-to-infrastructure-to-technology-to-bottleneck-to-company maps, successor constraints and explicit falsifiers and are structurally ready_for_chief. Structural readiness does not override underwriting blockers or global T0 gates.

companies.causalChain: AI demand -> accelerator clusters -> powered/networked/cooled datacenter capacity -> compute services -> productivity
companies.falsifier: persistent underutilization or compute-price compression outruns delivered-cost improvement

companies.causalChain: real-world monitoring -> high-cadence Earth observation -> constellation/data platform -> geospatial intelligence -> faster decisions
companies.falsifier: alternative fused datasets match cadence/quality with weaker switching costs and materially erode renewals

companies.causalChain: firm low-carbon power -> advanced fission -> licensing/fuel/siting -> grid/datacenter/industrial power -> energy security
companies.falsifier: licensed units fail bankable lifecycle economics or interest fails to convert to enforceable offtake

companies.causalChain: digital compute/Bitcoin demand -> powered sites/ASICs/AI infrastructure -> workloads -> digital monetary/compute services
companies.falsifier: AI conversion earns subpar returns while mining economics deteriorate

companies.causalChain: advanced computation/networking -> trapped-ion systems/networking/fabrication -> quantum workloads -> simulation/optimization/network optionality
companies.falsifier: no economically relevant advantage at scale or rival modality reaches useful fault tolerance with better economics first

companies.causalChain: labor scarcity/fulfillment pressure -> warehouse robotics/software -> automated handling -> distribution -> lower labor/time per unit
companies.falsifier: economics fail outside anchor customers or modular alternatives match throughput at lower integration cost

companies.causalChain: AI scaling -> custom silicon/electro-optics/networking -> cluster scale-out -> AI infrastructure -> lower cost/higher throughput
companies.falsifier: hyperscalers internalize design or rivals displace major programs enough to erode share/pricing

companies.causalChain: AI bandwidth -> lasers/transceivers/photonics -> optical links -> cluster networking -> scalable connectivity
companies.falsifier: copper remains economical much longer or photonics supply commoditizes critical components

companies.causalChain: AI bandwidth/power efficiency -> lasers/optics/CPO components -> optical fabric -> datacenter interconnect -> accelerator utilization
companies.falsifier: integrated architectures reduce external content or qualified supply expansion collapses scarcity rent

companies.causalChain: AI rack power density -> power-management ICs/modules -> rack power delivery -> datacenter electrical infrastructure -> reliable compute
companies.falsifier: platform integration bypasses material discrete content or capacity growth erodes margins without durable wins

companies.causalChain: AI/network demand -> design/manufacturing/supply integration -> hyperscaler deployment -> cloud/AI capacity -> compute services
companies.falsifier: vertical integration/ODM competition commoditizes contribution and erodes durable returns

companies.causalChain: bandwidth/electrification/defense connectivity -> connectors/cables/sensors -> signal/power delivery -> infrastructure -> reliable control/communication
companies.falsifier: architecture removes connector content faster than adaptation or acquisition expansion materially erodes ROIC/quality

contradictions: Structural bottleneck exposure does not prove value capture for NBIS, BTDR or OKLO.
COHR and LITE can both benefit from optical scarcity while capacity response can still weaken pricing durability.
Shared AI macro demand across MRVL/COHR/LITE/MPWR/CLS/APH is one correlated driver and must not be counted as independent evidence.
unknowns: Successor-bottleneck timing remains scenario uncertainty, not a current blocker where the causal link is sourced and falsifiable.
peerRequests: Underwriting: keep value capture separate from structural criticality for NBIS/OKLO/BTDR.
Beta red team: attack optical oversupply/substitution and hyperscaler vertical integration.
Discovery: watch AI power/interconnect/optics and advanced nuclear fuel/licensing successor constraints without double-counting correlated headlines.
